name: 6-demethylsterigmatocystin to acetylene
summary: A 7-step route from 6-demethylsterigmatocystin to acetylene, ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: demethylsterigmatocystin 6-O-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: 6-demethylsterigmatocystin + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = sterigmatocystin + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)

reactions.name: sterigmatocystin 8-O-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: sterigmatocystin + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 8-O-methylsterigmatocystin + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)

reactions.name: aflatoxin B synthase
reactions.equation: 8-O-methylsterigmatocystin + 2 reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + 2 O2 = aflatoxin B1 + methanol + 2 oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + CO2 + H2O + 2 H(+)

reactions.name: N,N-dimethyl-4-nitrosoaniline + methanol = 4-(hydroxylamino)-N,N-dimethylaniline + form...

reactions.name: alcohol dehydrogenase (nicotinoprotein)
reactions.equation: N,N-dimethyl-4-nitrosoaniline + ethanol = 4-(hydroxylamino)-N,N-dimethylaniline + acetaldehyde

reactions.name: acetylene hydratase
reactions.equation: acetaldehyde = acetylene + H2O

reactions.equation: glycine + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = sarcosine + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)

reactions.name: (RS)-norcoclaurine 6-O-methyltransferase

reactions.name: carotene epsilon-hydroxylase
reactions.equation: alpha-carotene + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + O2 = alpha-cryptoxanthin + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + H2O + H(+)

reactions.name: L-valine + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] + O2 = N-hydroxy-L-valine + oxidized ...

reactions.name: methylxanthine N(1)-demethylase
reactions.equation: theophylline + NADH + O2 + H(+) = 3-methylxanthine + formaldehyde + NAD(+) + H2O

reactions.equation: heme b + 5 AH2 + 4 O2 + 2 H(+) = delta-staphylobilin + Fe(2+) + formaldehyde + 5 A + 4 H2O

reactions.name: discadenine synthase
reactions.equation: N(6)-dimethylallyladenine + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = discadenine + S-methyl-5'-thioadenosine + H(+)

reactions.name: isonocardicin synthase
